item.name: EXIT: The Game – The Secret Lab

play.comments: Completed this 1-2 puzzles at a time when I had the time. I found it thematic and enjoyable. It was the version I'd given Bruce for Christmas 2022 and he gave it back to me this year thinking it would be too hard for him. The rest of the family didn't seem interested in these EXIT games so I played it solo and left it for Bruce again.

item.name: EXIT: The Game – The Secret Lab
EXIT: The Game – The Secret Lab

play.comments: Was a fun science themed EXIT escape game, the difficulty for me wasn't too had, and found most puzzles to make sense without the need of hints or research online! Would recommend!
